$comment: Eval set for render_ui guidance (generative-ui-2026 §6.4, P3). `expect` is what a good turn does. Run against a real model by the eval harness; the unit test only checks the set is well formed and balanced. The ui cases carry their data inline: a bare prompt gives the model nothing to show, so a text reply to it is correct.
